verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a first-party Diff Review feature: inline and side-by-side diffs across every modified file, with accept, reject, undo and redo of agent edits. That covers the inspection half of the story well. The checks half rests only on generic agent shell access to run commands and scripts, and nothing describes a pre-merge check, test-gate or merge-review workflow. Missing for 10: a documented check/test-running step tied to review, a pre-merge gate or merge workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of diff review.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Diff review — Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
For changes across multiple files, open the dedicated Diff Review page. It provides: A scrollable list of every modified file, Side-by-side diff view
Undo — Roll back all changes from a specific agent action. Redo — Reapply changes you previously undid
Shell access — Run shell commands, scripts, and package managers
